summary:
> AgriEye is a Precision Agriculture Analytics system that helps farmers treat every part of their field differently.
>
> Today farmers apply the same water and fertilizer to the whole field, which wastes water, increases cost, and reduces yield. Our solution combines Satellite data, Drone imaging, and Solar IoT soil sensors into one simple mobile dashboard.
>
> Using NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red), we create a Green-Yellow-Red map that shows which zone is healthy, which needs water, and which needs fertilizer. Our IoT sensors monitor soil moisture, NPK, salinity and temperature 24/7, enabling Variable Rate Irrigation.
>
> In our case study of a 351-hectare Sugarbeet field, the system prevented over-watering by detecting 18% topsoil moisture but 34% root-zone moisture. It saves water, money, and increases crop yield for small farmers.
details:
> *Project Title: Precision Agriculture Analytics - Smart Farming with Satellite, Drone & IoT*

>

> *What does it do / How does it work?*

> Our project helps farmers treat every part of their field differently instead of treating the whole field as one. It combines 3 data sources:

> 1. Satellite (NASA / Sentinel) - Gives NDVI map every 5 days to show healthy vs stressed crop zones. NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red)

> 2. Drone - Takes 10cm high-resolution images of only the problem zones identified by satellite.

> 3. IoT Sensors - Solar-powered soil sensors in the field that measure soil moisture, NPK, salinity, and soil temperature 24/7 using LoRaWAN.

>

> All data is fused on one Mobile Dashboard that shows a simple color map: Green = Healthy, Yellow = Needs Water/Fertilizer, Red = Critical.

>

> *Benefits & Intended Impact:*

> - Saves up to 30% water through Variable Rate Irrigation (VRI) - water only where needed.

> - Reduces fertilizer cost by applying NPK only in deficient zones.

> - Early disease & pest alert before visible damage.

> - Real Example from our study: In a 351-hectare Sugarbeet field, topsoil moisture was 18% but root-zone was 34%, our system prevented over-watering and root damage. In California Alfalfa field, with 28.78°C temp, 47% humidity and 20.38 km/h wind, our system advised evening irrigation to reduce evaporation loss.

> - Impact: Save Farmer Money, Save Water, Increase Yield, Protect Soil.

>

> *Tools, Languages, Hardware & Software Used:*

> Data: NASA / Sentinel-2 Satellite Data, Open Weather Data

> Software: Python, Google Earth Engine, QGIS, Leaflet / Streamlit for Dashboard

> Hardware: Solar IoT Soil Sensor (NPK + Moisture + Temp), LoRaWAN Module, Drone for RGB + Multispectral imaging

> Analytics: NDVI, NDMI, VRI Model, Soil Moisture Profiling

>

> *What is Creative?*

> Instead of giving farmers complex graphs, we convert satellite + sensor data into a simple Traffic Light Map and a local-language alert - "Yaha Paani Do, Yaha Khaad Do". One village sensor can serve the whole village, making it affordable for small farmers.

>

> *Factors Considered:*

> Low cost for small farmers, Solar power for no electricity villages, Offline / Low internet support, Local language, and Soil health protection.

2) USE OF SUPER INTELLIGENCE (SI) - Is box me ye daal de:

> We used Super Intelligence (SI) tools like Chatbots / Large Language Models to accelerate our work. SI was used for:

> 1. Research summarization on NDVI and Precision Agriculture concepts.

> 2. Drafting the presentation script and project description in simple language.

> 3. Generating ideas for dashboard UI and farmer-friendly alerts.

>

> All core logic, data analysis, NDVI calculation, case study interpretation, and final project decisions were done by our team. No NASA branding, logos, or mission identifiers were generated or modified using SI.
